_why: Pinned post-gate catalogue for tests that must prove the model ladder is resolved DYNAMICALLY (from what the provider actually serves) rather than falling back to the 3-model config seed. Copied verbatim from state/model_cache.json, which is what _write_cache stores: the post-gate id list, so no free/active/text filtering is skipped by using it. Read only via MODEL_SELECTOR_PIN, and only when the `opencode` CLI is genuinely absent. No committed workflow sets that variable - pinned by tests/workflows/test_workflow_lint.py - so production cannot reach this file and a genuinely broken selector in production still degrades loudly to the seed.
